observedCause: The preview iframe attempted to load the GSAP 3.12.5 MotionPathPlugin script from jsDelivr.
That HTMLScriptElement emitted an error event.
The injected fallback requested the 3.15.0 version, which also emitted an error event.
The fallback Promise rejected with the script Event; its unhandled rejection produced Event: Event.

sourceEvidence.behavior: NLEContext calls ensureMotionPathPluginLoaded on iframe load. It preloads the plugin even when no authored motionPath is present. Its own onerror finalizes; the separate CLI fallback rejects without a catch.

localAssetSearch.result: No MotionPathPlugin filename found. This does not prove that no copy exists elsewhere or inside archives.

interpretation: An editor startup dependency failed under local-only networking. This is not evidence of an audio-media failure or of the renderer memory root cause.
qualityStatus: Keep the original playback telemetry-failed receipt. Its audio timing and no-disruption subchecks passed; startup dependency handling remains unresolved.
limitations: Only startup was observed in this diagnostic; no playback, export, listening or full-video approval.
No network download or SDK/source patch was made.
